workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Finds dormant IDs in a RACF group, reports them, and revokes after manual approval.

variable.name: RACF_GROUP
variable.label: RACF Group
variable.abstract: The RACF group whose members will be scanned for dormant IDs
variable.description: All user IDs connected to this group will be checked. Only active (non-revoked) IDs are evaluated. Example: IZUADMIN

variable.name: DORMANT_DAYS
variable.label: Dormant Threshold (days)
variable.abstract: Number of days of inactivity after which a user ID is considered dormant
variable.description: Any user ID whose RACF LASTUSED date is older than this many days - or who has never logged on - will be flagged as dormant. Typical values: 90, 180, 365.

variable.name: REXX_DATASET
variable.label: REXX Library Dataset
variable.abstract: Dataset containing the DORMANT REXX exec
variable.description: The PDS or PDSE where the DORMANT REXX exec member resides. Example: ANDRE.REXX.EXEC

variable.name: AUDIT_DATASET
variable.label: Audit Dataset
variable.abstract: Sequential dataset to which the revocation run is appended
variable.description: An existing physical-sequential dataset that the optional audit step appends one record to, noting who ran the revocation, when, for which group, and at what threshold. Must already be allocated. Example: ANDRE.DORMANT.AUDIT

step.name: confirmGroup
step.title: Confirm RACF Group Exists
step.description: Runs LISTGRP to verify the target group exists and records its current member list before the dormancy scan begins.
step.instructions: Runs LISTGRP ${instance-RACF_GROUP} to confirm the group is valid and to capture a baseline member list. Review the output before proceeding.

step.name: dormantReport
step.title: Generate Dormant ID Report
step.description: Runs the DORMANT REXX exec in report-only mode. No changes are made to RACF. Produces a list of all IDs in the group flagged as dormant or never-used.
step.instructions:
This step scans all members of group ${instance-RACF_GROUP} using LISTUSER to read each user's LAST-ACCESS date from their RACF profile.
An ID is flagged DORMANT if its last logon was more than ${instance-DORMANT_DAYS} days ago, or NEVER-USED if no logon has ever been recorded.
Already-revoked IDs are reported as ALREADY-REVOKED and skipped.
This step is read-only - no RACF changes are made here. Review the report carefully before proceeding to the approval step.

step.name: approvalGate
step.title: Review and Approve Revocation
step.description: Manual checkpoint. A security administrator must review the dormant ID report from the previous step and explicitly complete this step to authorise revocation. Skipping or leaving this step incomplete will prevent the revoke step from running.
step.instructions:
APPROVAL REQUIRED BEFORE REVOCATION
Review the dormant ID report produced in the previous step.
Before completing this step confirm that: 1. You have reviewed every ID listed as DORMANT or NEVER-USED. 2. You have verified with application owners / the access management team that none of the flagged IDs are in active use by batch jobs, service accounts, or shared credentials. 3. You have obtained the required authorisation (change record, manager approval, etc.) per your site security policy. 4. You understand that the next step will issue ALTUSER ... REVOKE for every flagged ID in group ${instance-RACF_GROUP}.
Mark this step Complete only when all of the above are satisfied. If any IDs should be excluded, stop the workflow and adjust the group membership or dormancy threshold before restarting.

step.name: revokeDormantIDs
step.title: Revoke Dormant IDs
step.description: Runs the DORMANT REXX exec in REVOKE mode. Every ID flagged as DORMANT or NEVER-USED in the group will receive ALTUSER ... REVOKE. Requires the approval gate step to be complete.
step.instructions:
This step issues ALTUSER ... REVOKE for every active user ID in group ${instance-RACF_GROUP} whose last logon is older than ${instance-DORMANT_DAYS} days, or who has never logged on.
WARNING: This action modifies RACF. Revoked IDs cannot log on until explicitly restored with ALTUSER ... RESUME.
The step will exit RC=8 if any individual revocation fails; review SYSTSPRT to identify which IDs could not be revoked.

step.name: captureAudit
step.title: Capture Audit Record
step.description: Optional. Appends a single timestamped record of this revocation run to an existing sequential audit dataset, giving a durable trail of who ran the cleanup, when, for which group, and at what threshold. The revoked ID list itself remains in the previous step's output.
step.instructions:
Appends one record to ${instance-AUDIT_DATASET} recording that a revocation run was performed against group ${instance-RACF_GROUP} with a ${instance-DORMANT_DAYS}-day threshold.
The audit dataset must already exist as a physical-sequential dataset. This step makes no RACF changes.

template.inlineTemplate: /* Append an audit record of this revocation run. */ auditDS = "${instance-AUDIT_DATASET}" grp = "${instance-RACF_GROUP}" days = "${instance-DORMANT_DAYS}" rec = DATE('S') TIME() SYSVAR('SYSUID'), 'REVOKE run group='grp 'threshold='days'd' "ALLOC F(AUD) DA('"auditDS"') MOD REUSE" if rc = 0 then do queue rec "EXECIO 1 DISKW AUD (FINIS" "FREE F(AUD)" say 'Audit record written to' auditDS end else say 'Could not allocate' auditDS 'rc='rc EXIT 0
